prompts.text: An organized office work surface in pale wood, with a compact stack of forms and a single pen in soft daylight. A blurred file tray adds local admin context without crowding the surface.

debug.input_assessment: Source messaging is product-feature heavy but includes usable office/admin document-work cues, especially multi-page forms, records, packets, copies, and recurring workflows. Technical supply, connectivity, and control claims were not translated into scene elements unless they supported ordinary document context.
debug.count_explanation: Three numbered KSPs contain some activity or document-work cues, but they overlap around frequent administrative workflows. A single medium-view Office prompt preserves the strongest compatible cue without exceeding the selected view's prop and background limits.

ksp_mappings.explanation: The recurring document-output cue supports the stack of forms. Ink capacity, refill confidence, and all-in-one convenience were omitted as technical/product claims rather than environment details.

source_evidence.quote: Multi-page forms, records, packets, and copies
recurring admin work feels easier to manage

ksp_mappings.explanation: This is the main scene source. Multi-page forms and admin work were simplified into one compact stack of forms, a pen, and a small background file tray suitable for a medium oblique view.

source_evidence.quote: devices and connections that fit your space

ksp_mappings.explanation: Connectivity and supported device claims are abstract and product-dependent. They were not represented with phones, computers, cables, or network gear to avoid adding extra hardware or clutter.

source_evidence.quote: Everyday setup, scanning, and repeat tasks

ksp_mappings.explanation: The repeat-task workflow overlaps with the admin-document setting in p1. Touchscreen, phone shortcuts, guided setup, and scanning specifics were omitted because they are product-control details rather than environmental cues.

value_proposition.explanation: The value proposition reinforces an organized frequent-workflow context, used as a tidy office work surface with restrained admin details.

details: Pale wood work surface, soft daylight, a single pen, and a blurred file tray are plausible ordinary office details added to ground the document-work cue while staying within the medium-view limits.

omitted_or_simplified: Wireless, mobile, Ethernet, USB, and app claims
Extra supplies beyond two nearby props
adjustments.explanation: The resolved printer_FrontRightMedium profile allows a medium oblique local setting with at most two nearby props and one subordinate background detail. The prompt keeps a compact stack of forms and one pen as nearby props, with a single blurred file tray for office context.
